# WHP Decision Integrity Protocol

> DIP evaluates a structured proposed transition against supplied standing, authority, warrants, qualifiers, constraints, and requested force.

## Receipt propagation

- [Receipt companion and agent integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wheelerhubbell/DIP/main/PROPAGATION.md): Package an unchanged result with a route to WHP verification and a new evaluation; local and free.
- [Companion schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wheelerhubbell/DIP/main/public/receipt-companion.schema.json): Unsigned discovery metadata beside the signed receipt.

## Start here

- [Browser access and local receipt verification](https://decision-integrity.wheelerhubbell.chatgpt.site/dip): Use cases, on-device verification, and copyable agent instructions. No payment initiated by the page.

- [Live service access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wheelerhubbell/DIP/main/SERVICE_ACCESS.md): POST endpoint, price, example request, x402 instructions, and paid-path verification status.
- [Service descriptor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wheelerhubbell/DIP/main/public/service.json): Machine-readable endpoint and advertised payment requirements.
- [OpenAPI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wheelerhubbell/DIP/main/public/openapi.json): API description for callers and importers.
- [Input schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wheelerhubbell/DIP/main/public/evaluation-input.schema.json): Complete structured request contract.
- [Synthetic request](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wheelerhubbell/DIP/main/public/examples/inform.json): Informational fixture; no real-world execution authority.
- [Result schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wheelerhubbell/DIP/main/public/official-result.schema.json): Published official-result contract.
- [Verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wheelerhubbell/DIP/main/OFFICIAL_RESULT_VERIFICATION.md): Verify the returned result's signature.
- [Public key registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wheelerhubbell/DIP/main/public/.well-known/whp-dip-keys.json): WHP public verification keys.
- [Protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wheelerhubbell/DIP/main/PROTOCOL.md): Evaluation scope and limitations.
- [Public terms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wheelerhubbell/DIP/main/PUBLIC_TERMS.md): Governing public terms.

The endpoint is POST https://whp-dip-x402.vercel.app/api/evaluate. The payment challenge checked on 2026-09-10 advertised 1 USDC on Base mainnet via x402 v2. Paid evaluation and settlement have not yet been verified. These discovery files live in the public repository; no third-party directory listing is claimed.
